title: feat(spec): the liveness state table's counts become a generated artifact, and eleven drifted rows are reconciled (#7377)
body:
Closes #7377

Two stages in one PR, in the order the card fixed: **the per-row reconciliation first**, then the mechanism. Doing the mechanism first would have made CI red with no path to green.

## Stage 1 — per-row reconciliation

Re-measured fresh on this branch's `main` (`d13ce33`, which includes PR #7425). The card counted **9** drifted rows against `f188ed6`; the current answer is **11** — #7425 merged at 11:28Z and moved `job` and `translation` as the #7131 seat's 10:46Z comment predicted, and `action` moved once more (41 → 42) when PR #7430 landed `action.description`.

Every delta is decomposed against the commit that last wrote that row's numbers (found with `git log -L <line>,<line>:README.md`), then reconciled key-by-key against the ledger at that commit. Arithmetic closes exactly on all eleven: `README = ledger@base + envelope@base`, `now = ledger@HEAD + envelope@HEAD`.

| Row | README said | `--json` says | Delta — what actually moved | Prose action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | 59 / – / 0 / – | **66** / 0 / 0 / 0 | +7 live = the ADR-0010 protection envelope entering the walked shape at **#4531** (`field` closes, #4001). Ledger unchanged: 59 → 59. | none — the Note makes no claim about the count |
| `flow` | 34 / – / 5 / – | 34 / 0 / **6** / 0 | +1 dead = `errorHandling.retryDelayMs`, RENAMED to `backoffMs` at **#4964**; the old spelling is tombstoned and the new one enters as its own `live` row, so live stands still while dead moves | **rewritten** — the Note said "4 tombstone entries + the kept docs field"; it now says 5 and names the fifth |
| `action` | 34 / 0 / 2 / – | **42** / 0 / 2 / 0 | +7 envelope (**#4533**, batch 6d) **+1 live** `description` (**#7367** / PR #7430) | **extended** — dead set unchanged and still exactly `shortcut` + `bulkEnabled`; the new live key is named |
| `hook` | 11 / – / 2 / – | **18** / 0 / 2 / 0 | +7 envelope (**#4514**) | none — "label/description dead but KEPT" still true |
| `page` | 16 / – / – / 1 | **23** / 0 / 0 / 1 | +7 envelope (**#4530**) | none — "fully live + one planned" still true |
| `view` | 79 / 0 / 4 / – | **80** / 0 / **6** / 0 | **#4534** (the last #4001 batch, 6e) declared three *container-level* keys this row never classified: `object` live, `name` dead, `label` dead | **rewritten** — the hand-enumerated dead set was the 4 removals against a real 6 |
| `webhook` | 11 / 0 / 0 / – | **19** / 0 / 0 / 0 | +8 envelope incl. `protection` (**#4974**, batch 11) | none — "the surviving surface is fully live" still true |
| `app` | 45 / – / 9 / – | **46** / 0 / 9 / **1** | **dead 9 still reconciles exactly** (7 `retiredKey` tombstones + `homePageId` + `areas.description`). +1 live `_unpublished` (**#4829** / PR #6942), +1 planned `navigation.runAction` (**#4848** / PR #7253) | **extended** — the 9-vs-7 reconciliation is preserved verbatim as still-true; the two additions are explained |
| `seed` | 5 / – / 0 / – | **12** / 0 / 0 / 0 | +7 envelope (**#4514**) | none — "fully live via SeedLoaderService" still true |
| `job` | 13 / 0 / 2 / 0 | **15** / 0 / **0** / 0 | `label` + `description` re-graded dead → live by **#7131** / PR #7425 | **rewritten** — see below |
| `translation` | 17 / – / 2 / – | **19** / – / **0** / – | `name` + `label` re-graded dead → live by **#7131** / PR #7425 | **rewritten** — see below, and the finding |

The other **24 rows are byte-identical**, verified mechanically by re-extracting both tables and comparing the Notes text.

### Six rows, one cause

`field`, `action`, `hook`, `page`, `seed`, `webhook` all moved by exactly the size of the ADR-0010 protection envelope (`protection`, `_lock*`, `_provenance`, `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`), which the gate auto-classifies `live` on every type that spreads `MetadataProtectionFields`. Each row's number predates the #4001 batch that closed that schema and picked the envelope up. That is the "something structural moved" the card guessed at for `seed` 5 → 12 and `webhook` 11 → 19, and it is now written into the README's counting-method section as a standing corollary rather than repeated in six cells — no author writes those keys, so they are never a Notes-cell subject.

### `job` — the first zero-dead row where ADR-0033 is still in force

Said out loud in the row, per the dispatch: the keys are still docs-shaped, still deliberately KEPT, still not `authorWarn`'d, and enforce-or-remove still has nothing to chase. What changed is only that the exemption no longer has to carry the verdict — the measurement does.

### `translation` — the pre-existing contradiction, measured

The #7131 seat flagged it; re-measured here at `7d2158146`, the very commit that wrote the row:

- the cell published `dead 2` beside a sentence reading *"Dead 1 = `validationMessages` (authorWarn)"*;
- at that commit `validationMessages` is **absent from `props`** — the same change had just removed it (#4667), and the cell's own right-hand block says so;
- the real dead 2 were `name` and `label`, which the sentence never mentions.

So the number was right and the prose was false, **in the same cell, on the day it was written**. That is not #7425's doing and not staleness — it is exactly the failure mode the card's *"a row that says `dead 6` next to a sentence enumerating four"* argument is about, and this table's own worked example of it. It is recorded in the row rather than quietly deleted, and #7425 resolves it by emptying the dead set.

### One more finding, fixed here

Five rows (`dashboard`, `app`, `book`, `job`, `translation`) carried a **seventh cell against a six-column header**. GFM drops cells beyond the header count, so several hundred words of measured prose — `dashboard`'s whole `**#4956**` block, `app`'s `**#4651**`/`**#4667**` blocks — **rendered nowhere**. The 2-column table folds each trailing cell back into its Notes cell losslessly (concatenation, no rewording), which makes that prose visible for the first time.

## Stage 2 — the mechanism

Per the #5107 strictness-ledger precedent, adopted as the PM's claim comment directed.

- **New artifact** `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts.md` — the four status columns plus a `classified` column and a total row, in `GOVERNED` order. Routed `merge=os-regen` in `.gitattributes` and declared in `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`.
- **New generator** `gen:liveness-counts` (`scripts/liveness/build-state-counts.mts`). It **spawns `check-liveness.mts --json`** rather than re-implementing the walk: a second walker would be a second definition of "classified", and the one that wins would be whichever the artifact happened to be rendered from. Its exit code is deliberately ignored (the gate is red precisely when a regeneration is needed) but a crash is fatal — no parseable report, no write.
- **The README keeps the prose.** The table is now `| Type | Notes |`. Regenerating a Note would manufacture a verdict, which that README calls worse than a missing row, so `liveness/README.md` is emphatically *not* driver-managed — stated in both `.gitattributes` and the regen table.
- **`readme-table.mts` extended** with `foldStateCounts` / `renderStateCounts` / `reconcileStateCounts`. Three legs, each invisible to the other two:
  1. **freshness** — the artifact equals what the gate measures right now, by **byte comparison against a re-render**, never a second parser (#5107's rule);
  2. **row set** — README rows and artifact rows agree in both directions, reconciled against the *rendered* artifact so a stale file does not report the same defect twice;
  3. **no hand counts** — a README row whose cells beyond the type name include a bare number (or the `–` the old table used) fails. A re-added column would leave legs 1 and 2 green while the table published two sets of numbers with only one enforced — strictly worse than the drift this card started from.
- **`check:liveness` moves from `NO_GENERATOR` to `GATED`** in `check-generated.ts`, mirroring what #5107 did for `check:strictness-ledger`, and last among non-ratchet entries on the cheapest-first rule.
- **#7374's option-2 skeleton is preserved, relocated.** The python snippet's count half is superseded by `gen:`; its skeleton half — print `| <type> | **NO ROW YET (#7257) …** |` for a governed type with no row — now lives in the generator, prefers the gate's own `readmeMissingRows` over a second read of the README, and still stops at the type name so it can never guess a Notes cell. The fence-skipping branch in `parseStateTable` is unchanged and still unit-tested.

### Regeneration discipline

`state-counts.md` is **script-generated from source** — the gate walks `src/` Zod schemas through tsx and reads the ledger JSON. It is **not** dist-derived, so no `pnpm build` precedes regeneration and the entry carries no `readsDist` / `readsSchemaTree`. Four steps run in order: generate → run the gate → run the gate's tests → `git-merge-regen.mjs --self-test`.

## Reverse verification

Predicted in writing, then run against a mutated `--ledger-root` copy (no tracked file touched):

| Mutation | Predicted | Observed |
|---|---|---|
| delete `state-counts.md` | red, `MISSING`, plus the regenerate prescription | ✅ exit 1, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts.md is MISSING — the table's numbers are published by nothing.` |
| skew one count (`view` live 80 → 81) | red, `STALE`, naming the differing line | ✅ exit 1, `first difference at line 42: - | `view` | 81 … / + | `view` | 80 …` |
| re-add a count column to the `object` row | red, naming the line and the cells | ✅ exit 1, `line 789 (object) — 4 count cell(s): 49, –, 0, 1` |
| delete the `qa` README row | red on **both** the #7257 heading and the new row-set heading | ✅ exit 1, `qa` under both |
| verbatim copy (control) | green | ✅ exit 0, `state-counts.md is current — the same 30 row(s), no count column left in the README.` |

All four mutations are also encoded as integration cases in `check-liveness.test.ts`, spawning the real gate and reading the real exit code.

## Gates

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` | ✅ green |
| liveness script tests (`scripts/liveness`) | ✅ 9 files / **186** tests (was 166 — +14 unit, +5 integration, +1 control) |
| `readme-table.test.ts` alone | ✅ 34 tests (20 pre-existing, unmodified) |
| `check-generated-ledger.test.ts` | ✅ 8/8 |
| `check:generated --reconcile-only` | ✅ 21 `check:` + 15 `gen:` all classified (12 gated) |
| `node scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs --self-test` | ✅ `.gitattributes` ↔ regen table agree on **12** paths; all 24 gen:/check: names resolve |
| `node scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs` | ✅ exit 0 |
| `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json` | ✅ clean |
| `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` | ✅ OK |

## Changeset

`@objectstack/spec: patch` — `liveness/` ships in the published `files` array, so both the rewritten `README.md` and the new `state-counts.md` land in the tarball. Skip-changeset does not apply for the same reason #7374's did not; patch for the same reason, no runtime or type surface moves.

## Out of scope, deliberately

No `content/docs/releases/`, no `docs/adr/**`. The `translation` contradiction and the dropped-seventh-cell defect are recorded above as measured history rather than filed as new issues — the first was already reported on #7377 by the #7131 seat and is resolved by #7425, and the second is fixed by this PR's own table restructure.
